caveats: ⚑ TARGET IDENTITY — every one of this unit's three skills is scoped to a kit-named single ally ('the king'), a designated-ally selector this schema has no primitive for. Modeled as alliesTopAtk count:1 excludeSelf:true (highest-static-ATK ally other than the caster) as a documented stand-in. If the real selector is positional (leftmost/adjacent), by-final-ATK, or a user-chosen designation, the recipient changes and so does every number below. This is the single highest-leverage unknown in the model.
⚑ cadence tuple (SMG 120 ammo / 81 reloadFrames / hitsPerShot 1) is datamine-sourced and known-unreliable; effective pulls/s is frame-quantized by the engine. Not overridden here.
⚑ Burst 'Re-enters Burst Stage 2' is modeled as a reenterStage effect so another Burst-II unit can also cast; whether the re-entry consumes the same rotation slot in-game is unverified.
All three magnitudes (46.46 / 46.22 / 92.44) are kit-literal, not calibrated — no ⚑ on the values themselves.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. chime is a Burst-II SMG/Iron Supporter whose entire kit funnels into ONE designated ally ('the king'): S1 grants that ally a continuous flat ATK add equal to 46.46% of chime's OWN ATK (casterAtkPct — scales off the caster's sheet, not the recipient's); S2 grants that ally Normal Attack Damage Multiplier ▲46.22% for 10s on Full Burst ENTRY (kit says 'Activates when entering Full Burst' — team-wide FB trigger, NOT own-burst-gated, so it fires on any team Full Burst); burst gives ALL allies Max Ammunition ▲20%/10s (a weapon-state modifier — it gates shots fired, therefore damage, and is modeled, not skipped) plus Re-enters Burst Stage 2, and gives the designated ally Attack Damage ▲92.44%/10s (Damage-Up bucket, generic, not scoped to normal attacks). S2's 'Normal Attack Damage Multiplier' is scoped to the normal-attack multiplier (normalAttackPct), deliberately NOT the generic attackDamagePct bucket — conflating them would over-credit skill and burst damage. The burst's Attack Damage line IS generic and correctly sits in the Damage-Up bucket. Self-damage contribution is a plain SMG cycle with no self-buffs; chime is a pure enabler whose entire value is the single-target funnel. FB-by-timing is default ON for all riders (no noFb set, none measured). The one structural risk is the target selector — see caveats.
